atoms.sound: It’s my 15th birthday this weekend, and I’m having a party to celebrate! My actual birthday is on Sunday, but I’m going out with my family for the day, so the party will be on Saturday instead. It will start at 4pm, as I’m going swimming at 10am and I will need time to set everything up.

atoms.a: Why can’t Mei have her party on Sunday?
atoms.sound: Why can’t May have her party on Sunday?
b: She needs enough time to set everything up.
She is going swimming in the morning.

sound.end: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f2_chirp'>The party will be this Saturday!</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f2_chirp'>The party will start at 4:00 pm.</voice>

atoms.sound: I also need to choose a location for the party. I like the idea of going bowling, but unfortunately the bowling alley is closed this weekend, so I’m going to have it at home instead. My parents are letting me invite all of my friends!
